title: Memory Match
subtitle: Match all card pairs as quickly as possible.
rulesPairs: Flip two cards to find matching pairs.
rulesScore: Finish faster with fewer moves for a higher score. Consecutive match combos give bonus points.
rulesAudio: Audio is synthesized directly in the browser and can be muted at any time.
leaderboardNote: Your best score will be automatically recorded on the weekly, monthly, and all-time leaderboards.
